text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — alignment fixed, but follow-up fixes are separate commits**

New: The author pushed three more commits that fix the icon alignment laurynmm asked about, and says the screenshots are updated. Missing: The alignment, formatting and 1px fixes need to be squashed into the first commit, and several self-review checklist items are still unchecked (responsiveness and internationalization, strings and tooltips, corner cases).

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" for now; once the commits are squashed, hand it to laurynmm (who gave the alignment feedback) for review.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for fixing the alignment! Please squash the "Align", "prettier" and "Nudge" commits into the first commit so each commit is a complete change (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)), and finish the remaining self-review checklist items. Then comment here and we'll take another look.
```
